data.name: Diana
data.gender_notes: Diana is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin divus, 'divine', or dies, 'day' — 'heavenly'. Its root is Latin divus / dies. A classical name later used by Christians; borne by Saint Diana. Diana is a Latin name meaning “Divine; heavenly”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Diana expresses “Divine; heavenly”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin divus, 'divine', or dies, 'day' — 'heavenly'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Diana total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
